title: Dossier
description: The frontmatter of a dossier (Ds): recon and findings distilled by the pilot for the commander's desk, from which requests are raised. Filed by identifier alone, Ds006.md.

type.description: the word Dossier, which is what chooses this schema

unit.description: this dossier's identifier, Ds and three digits, with or without a dash before the digits (Ds006 or Ds-006), the same identifier the file is named for. Both forms are accepted until the rename after run 3 settles on the dash

name.description: one to three words the writer chose for the record's contents, appended to the file name after the id (CA-049)

stamp.description: three items: the date as YYYY-MM-DD, who wrote it, and the eight-character session id

work.description: the mission this dossier belongs to, M and three digits

context.description: the identifiers this dossier answers to, a bracketed list; a dossier's context is its dispatch, T and three digits. Also accepts the new commander and pilot record prefixes, which carry a dash before their three digits (CO-012), now that the corpus has moved to that shape. The old Rq, P, Or and De forms are accepted only until XD-005's citation sweep replaces them

generates.description: the identifiers of the documents this dossier led to, a bracketed list, usually the requests it raised. Also accepts the new commander and pilot record prefixes, which carry a dash before their three digits (XR-015), now that the corpus has moved to that shape. The old Rq, P, Or and De forms are accepted only until XD-005's citation sweep replaces them
